recommendation: Keep the source fix. It implements the published wording/link correction without changing the underlying QuestionnaireResponse model.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive with Modification issue for ambiguous representation of repeating groups in QuestionnaireResponse, requesting an explicit item.item versus item.answer.item sentence and a Questionnaire link to the moved QuestionnaireResponse diagram.
initial_application: Git e509bea3c2 moved the diagram and added Questionnaire link text, but left a self-link to questionnaire.html#link and did not apply the approved rewording of the QuestionnaireResponse.item comment.
additional_context: The issue is tightly connected to FHIR-12071 because its resolution names the same group-nesting sentence. FHIR-10481, FHIR-20768, and FHIR-31357 support retaining both recursion points while making their use clearer.
reconciliation: Updated the active QuestionnaireResponse StructureDefinition comment to state that group contents are item.item, not item.answer.item, and corrected the active Questionnaire narrative to link to questionnaireresponse.html#link without stale 'diagram on the right' wording.
source_changes: source/questionnaireresponse/structuredefinition-QuestionnaireResponse.xml: clarified QuestionnaireResponse.item group nesting as item.item, not item.answer.item.
source/questionnaire/questionnaire-notes.xml: corrected the QuestionnaireResponse diagram link and removed stale local diagram wording.
